LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Lantern: The aspect of the Glory and merciless illumination.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Forge: The aspect of transformation, fire, and artifice.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Edge: The aspect of battle, cunning, and struggle.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Winter: The aspect of silence, endings, and pale cold.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Heart: The aspect of ceaseless rhythm, protection, and life.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Grail: The aspect of hunger, delight, and blood.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Moth: The aspect of the Wood, change, and unreason.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.Knock: The aspect of doors, apertures, and wounds.
LanguageData.Cultist.AspectDesc.SecretHistories: The aspect of hidden pasts and forgotten vaults.

LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.AlreadyActiveReason: Clear the current world-map site first
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.SiteMarked: Suppression Bureau Act {0} outpost has been marked on the world map.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.RescuedHeretic: Rescued heretic {0} (Rank 2 {1} disciple) joined the colony.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.Brief1: Veteran hunter Douglas has set up a field listening post compiling files on your society. Strike first to seize his dossiers and cut notoriety.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.QuestDesc1: Assault Douglas's listening post and open the inner vault chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.DoneBody1: The post lies in ash; Douglas's ciphers and dossiers are yours. Half the Bureau's ears in this sector just went deaf.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.Brief2: Spencer guards an underground evidence vault packed with confiscated occult manuscripts. Break the seals and reclaim forbidden knowledge.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.QuestDesc2: Breach Spencer's evidence vault and open the sanctum chest to recover confiscated tomes.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.DoneBody2: Confiscated editions return to the light. The Bureau now realizes you are no longer hiding in the dark.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.Brief3: Natalia holds captured heretics inside a fortified interrogation house. Break in to cripple their intelligence and recruit a Rank 2 disciple.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.QuestDesc3: Storm Natalia's interrogation house and open the vault chest to free the captive disciple.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.DoneBody3: The iron cells stand open and the rescued heretic swears loyalty to your society. The Bureau's regional net is tearing apart.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.Brief4: The Bureau's two deadliest hunters now command the forward headquarters together. Defeating them exposes the regional Directorate itself.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.QuestDesc4: Defeat Connie Lee and Zachary at Hunter Command and seize the vault chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.DoneBody4: Hunter Command has fallen. Only the regional Directorate remains standing.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.Brief5: Burn the Directorate's master archives to permanently cripple the Bureau's chain of command on this world, halving all future notoriety gain.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.QuestDesc5: Assault the Suppression Bureau Regional Directorate and open the final vault chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.BureauAct.DoneBody5: The archive tower collapses in flame. The Suppression Bureau's regional network is broken—all future notoriety gain is permanently halved.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.Title: A Fugitive at the Gate
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.Speaker: Fugitive Heretic
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.Body: A bloodied stranger clutching a wrapped manuscript stumbles to your gate, pursued by Suppression Bureau hounds.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.SacrificeReason: Grail, Winter, or Edge societies only
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.Sheltered: Fugitive heretic {0} joined the colony with a tier 2 lore book.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.TurnedIn: The Bureau collected the fugitive (−20 notoriety, +400 silver).
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Heretic.Sacrificed: The altar answered: gained strength 10 influence and a cracked rite tool.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Poppy.Title: Poppy Lascelles's Midnight Visit
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Poppy.Speaker: Poppy Lascelles
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Poppy.Body: A crimson lantern pauses outside your door. "Two civil bargains tonight—sell me one of your treatises, or accept my generous advance."
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Poppy.NeedLore2: Requires a tier 2+ lore book on the map
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Poppy.Traded: Poppy departed with the book, leaving coin, silver, and quieter streets.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Title: A Bureau Mole in the Society
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Speaker: Altar Omen
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Body: Rising notoriety has drawn infiltration. Someone inside the settlement is passing ritual schedules to the Suppression Bureau.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Cleared: The mole was quietly removed (−18 notoriety).
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Misled: False dossiers misled the Bureau (−25 notoriety, next raid delayed 20 days).
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Mole.Purged: The informant was purged and a Bureau dossier recovered, leaving a chill behind.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.Title: Oriflamme's Underground Lot
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.Speaker: Oriflamme's Auction House
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.Body: Tonight's private gavel opens only to Spintriae. Available Spintriae on map: {0}.
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.OptLore4: Bid on a Tier 4 lore treatise
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.OptBooks: Bid on two classic occult books
LanguageData.Cultist.Visitor.Auction.Bought: Sold! Your lot has been drop-podded to the colony.
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.HubBody: Accept a field contract or switch to Spintria emergency support. Available Spintriae: {0}.

LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteTitle1: Tier I Bounty · Rogue Spirit Nest
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteDesc1: Clear the rogue spirits and open the vault chest to claim your Tier I bounty.
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteTitle2: Tier II Bounty · Bureau Convoy Post
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteDesc2: Raid the Suppression Bureau convoy post and open the vault chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteTitle3: Tier III Bounty · Rampant Spirit Sanctum
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.SiteDesc3: Defeat the rampant elite spirits and open the inner sanctum chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.Accepted: Accepted Tier {0} occult bounty. The target is marked on the world map.
LanguageData.Cultist.Bounty.Completed: Tier {0} occult bounty completed! Bonus rewards dropped beside the chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.Support.Title: Spintria Emergency Support
LanguageData.Cultist.Support.Speaker: Pacts of the Mansus
LanguageData.Cultist.Support.Body: Spend Spintriae to call immediate spirit reinforcements or erase notoriety. Available Spintriae: {0}.
LanguageData.Cultist.Support.SpiritsArrived: {0} contracted spirit reinforcements arrived for 12 hours!
LanguageData.Cultist.Support.Cleansed: Underground brokers scrubbed your files (−45 notoriety) and delivered a dossier.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Body1: The immortal {0} has taken notice of your rising marks and is feeding leads about your society to mortal authorities.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Body2: {0} has dispatched seasoned assassins to sever your society's leadership under cover of night.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.RaidBody: Assassins loyal to the rival Long {0} have breached the perimeter!
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Title3: Nemesis III · Curse of the Mansus
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Body3: {0} channels a bitter curse across the Threshold, threatening your leader with fascination and dread.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Body4: Tracing the backwash of the curse reveals {0}'s earthly fortress. Storm the sanctum and open its vault to end their interference forever.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.Tag4Launch: Final battle · Stops Rival Long raids + Tier 5 Lore
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.FortressDesc: Assault {0}'s hidden fortress, defeat the rival Long, and open the final vault chest.
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.FortressMarked: {0}'s hidden sanctum has been marked on the world map!
LanguageData.Cultist.RivalArc.DoneBody: {0}'s sanctum lies in ruin. Your immortal rival will trouble your ascension no more.
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.Speaker: Clandestine Post
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.FirstBody: A courier leaves a stamped brown-paper invoice on your threshold: post-box rental, coded dispatches, and mundane society upkeep totaling {0} silver.\n\nAvailable silver: {1}.
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.RecurringBody: Fifteen days have passed. Another stamped notice slips beneath the door: maintaining your society's aliases, dispatches, and daily living requires {0} silver.\n\nAvailable silver: {1}.
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.DefaultedMsg: {0} defaulted on society upkeep and suffers arrears penalties for 15 days.
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.PoppyBody:
Before you can turn the invoice away, the clerk quietly slides across a velvet calling card sealed in crimson wax—your 500-silver account was settled in full last night.

On the reverse, in Poppy Lascelles's crisp hand:
"My dear {0}, consider your first postage and lodging taken care of. I despise watching promising newcomers stumble over petty silver. Do not fret over gratitude—when winter draws closer, we shall have ample time to discuss a far more civilized return."
LanguageData.Cultist.PostOffice.PoppySettledMsg: Poppy Lascelles quietly settled your first 500-silver post-office bill.
